abstract: We present a lightweight, height-balanced search structure that underpins the Aether-Terminus command execution engine. The structure guarantees strict height-balance and key-order invariants while supporting point and range queries in $O(\log N)$ time. Formal proofs establish that rebalancing preserves the invariants after every insertion. Static Abstract Syntax Tree inspection confirms that the implementation contains a single function block and 1 SLOC, yielding an auxiliary memory bound of $O(N)$. No empirical runtime measurements are reported; all claims are supported by theoretical analysis and AST profiling. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/csharp-enterprise-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261125_030223_aether-terminus_arbitrary_comm}
